properties.description: Built 2026-10-22 (phase 7 PR 4, epoch:planned-p7-a-hub-on-one-machine), governed by dec:two-designs-are-linked-on-exact-evidence-and-a-similar-name-is-only-a-candidate. Core touch.rs where_designs_touch reads export documents only: DECLARED links are cross-design references one design records (Resource design-node-reference, xref:<design>:<node>) to a node of another composed design; COMPUTED links, on exact evidence only, are (1) the same file: an Artifact location qualified by its design's repository (the normalised `source` of any pin, in any composed design, naming that design's graph_id), or a URL, which qualifies itself, matched in two designs; or an equal checksum (algorithm prefix and case ignored), except the digest of empty content and a file every repository carries (README, LICENSE, Cargo.toml, __init__.py and the like by name), which are counted under set_aside.common_content_checksums; a bare relative path in two designs no shared repository qualifies is counted under set_aside.bare_path_matches, never a link; an absolute path is never evidence; (2) a pin (external_dependency, Resource design-dependency) in one design naming another's graph_id (pin_names_graph_id) or, without that, its source repository (pin_names_repository), drawn from the pin to the other design's anchor: the node of its design network with the most traceability edges, ties to the smallest id. CANDIDATES: Interfaces in two designs with the same stated medium whose lower-cased names score at least 85 on the pairing module's token_sort_ratio; never drawn, never read by a check. compose.rs draws every declared and computed link whose ends exist as a real DEPENDS_ON edge (properties link: computed|declared, evidence, note) in the throwaway combined graph BEFORE detect_gaps and open_defects run, so the ordinary checks see across it (a design joined to the others no longer reads as a cut-off cluster); `drawn` says whether it was. Replies: compose_and_analyse with several designs adds declared_links, computed_links, candidates, link_status ({linked: {a×b: counts}, candidates_only, never_touch, not_checked}, the not-composed designs' pairs as not_checked), set_aside, repositories, links_note, counts.links and counts.link_status; the composed_note carries Anthony's choice (a) sentence that a design with no link to the others reads as a cut-off cluster. The one-other-design reply keeps its eight keys and adds declared_links, computed_links, candidates, link_status, set_aside, links_note (ids in the old namespace::id form). pair_designs adds declared_links, computed_links, link_status (exact evidence only: its own name pairs never make a pair linked), set_aside, links_note. On a registry (flo2.io) the same is computed from each member's LIVE store as read through the one door. The bound samples the link lists, never link_status. LIMIT: a pin threads only itself to the design it names, so a hub whose pins nothing in it is wired to still reads each member as cut off (measured on the 15-export fixture: 118 cut-off clusters before and after; with the hub's pins wired to one component, 119 -> 101, the 101 being each member's own 86 plus 15 that two component-less members' own checks suppress at genesis); answers part of fact:defect-whether-a-project-link-is-real-cannot-be-asked (the link_status rollup, for compositions and pairings; mirrors' surface hash is not read).
properties.name: A composition and a pairing compute where their designs already touch on exact evidence, draw each link as a labelled edge, list name matches as candidates, and give every pair a link_status
